description: Lists, creates, renames, or deletes branches. List mode returns `{ branches, current }`. Mutations (create/delete/rename/setUpstream) return a compact confirmation `{ success, action, ... }` instead of the full listing — call again without a mutation param to list. When several mutations are combined in one call, the confirmation describes the last one performed. Pass `path` to target a specific repo or worktree — when omitted, operates on the server's own working directory, not the caller's (see #876).

create.description: Create a new branch with this name

delete.description: Delete branch(es) — pass a single name or an array of names

force.description: Force branch creation even if it exists (-f)

forceDelete.description: Force-delete unmerged branches (-D). Pass true (requires `delete` param), a branch name string, or an array of branch names.

merged.description: Filter to branches merged into HEAD (--merged)

mergedInto.description: Opt-in ancestry check: for each listed branch, add `merged` (fully contained in this ref) and `unmerged` (commit count not yet in the ref). Safe-delete predicate for cleanup workflows.

noMerged.description: Filter to branches not merged into HEAD (--no-merged)

path.description: Repository path. Authoritative — when omitted, the server uses its own process working directory (its launch dir, not the caller's cwd). Callers in a git worktree or other directory MUST pass this explicitly to avoid operating on the wrong repo.

rename.description: New name when renaming the current branch (-m/-M)

startPoint.description: Start point for branch creation (commit, tag, or branch)

switchAfterCreate.description: Switch to the created branch after creation (uses git switch)

name: branch
title: Git Branch
